missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend magnesium until renal status, current products and medication context are clarified and clinician review is obtained where indicated.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer magnesium deficiency from kidney disease or nonspecific symptoms.
Do not treat glycinate as exempt from magnesium-related safety concerns.
Do not duplicate magnesium across products.
professional_escalation_conditions: Chronic kidney disease, reduced eGFR, dialysis, hypermagnesemia or medicines with relevant interactions.
population_and_context: People with kidney disease considering magnesium glycinate; reduced renal clearance may increase risk of magnesium accumulation.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; assess elemental magnesium, kidney function and total exposure with a clinician.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Magnesium fact sheet describes toxicity risk in impaired renal function; salt form does not remove renal clearance concerns. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
